summary: Iteration 155 — Backend-only re-verification after visual-polish refactor of _render_liveblog_html (news_public.py): switched <ol> -> <ul class='clara-liveblog-timeline'>, replaced literal ● char with a styled dot <span> inside the LIVE pill, wrapped 'Liveblog beëindigd' in a rounded badge, and added inline styles to every clara-liveblog-* element. Ran the two existing pytest suites: /app/backend/tests/test_liveblog_body_html.py (8 cases, updated by main agent to match the new <ul>/pill markup) and /app/backend/tests/test_liveblog_publish_flow.py (8 cases, untouched). All 16 PASSED in 138.62s. Manually cross-checked the rendered HTML produced by routers/news_public.py against every assertion bullet in the review request: (a) exactly one <ul class='clara-liveblog-timeline' present, zero <ol> and zero 'list-style:decimal'; (b) every <li class='clara-liveblog-entry'> carries an inline 'list-style:none' (S_ENTRY / S_ENTRY_ENDED constants both prepend it); (c) ended pill emits class='clara-liveblog-status clara-liveblog-ended' with inline style containing border-radius:9999px and background:#f4f4f5, and the text is 'Liveblog beëindigd' (+ ' op {date}' when liveblog_ended_at set); (d) LIVE pill emits class='clara-liveblog-status clara-liveblog-live' with inline background:#fee2e2;color:#b91c1c, contains the literal text 'LIVE', and the leading dot is now a styled <span> (no '●' character in the live pill); (e) inline styles confirmed on section, header, title, count, list, entry, time, entry-title, entry-body, media, figure, img, figcaption, embed and video. No new tests added — existing coverage from iterations 153/154 plus main-agent's update fully exercises the new markup.
critical_code_review_comments: S_ENTRY and S_ENTRY_ENDED both hard-code border-left:3px solid #ef4444 / #d4d4d8 — fine, but the red 3px stripe is now applied to entries whether the liveblog is live or ended. The is_live flag does flip the stripe colour (S_ENTRY when live, S_ENTRY_ENDED when ended), so this is correct; just noting the per-entry colour is global to the article state, not the entry's own timestamp/state. Probably intended.

Inline styles are now baked into every <span>/<li>/<figure>. This makes the markup ~30% heavier per liveblog. For very long liveblogs (50+ entries) the body grows quickly. If grk.fm caches body HTML aggressively this is fine, otherwise consider a single <style scoped> block at the top of the section to dedupe repeated declarations.

Header count text still uses English plural 'updates' (e.g. '3 updates') even though the surrounding UI labels are Dutch ('Liveblog beëindigd'). Consider 'updates'/'update' both in Dutch ('updates'/'update' is actually the same Dutch loanword, so technically fine — flagging only for explicit copy review).
_html.escape is applied to ended_label but NOT to the LIVE pill text 'LIVE' (it's a constant string, so safe). Consistent treatment is fine; just noting for future maintainers.
The styled-dot <span> inside the LIVE pill uses width/height .5rem — at very small font-sizes the dot can disappear on retina screens that round to 0.5px. Not a functional issue, purely cosmetic.
seed_data_creation: Both test files create their own TEST_LBHTML_* / TEST_LIVEBLOG_* content_items via /api/content and force status=published + approval_status=approved directly in Mongo. Module-scoped cleanup fixtures tear down all created liveblog_entries and content_items at end of session.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two regression suites cover the liveblog feature: tests/test_liveblog_body_html.py (HTML markup, now expects <ul class='clara-liveblog-timeline'> and status pill classes 'clara-liveblog-status clara-liveblog-live'/'clara-liveblog-ended' — no literal '●' inside the LIVE pill) and tests/test_liveblog_publish_flow.py (auto-publish + visibility gates). Re-run: cd /app/backend && pytest tests/test_liveblog_body_html.py tests/test_liveblog_publish_flow.py -v. Total runtime ~140s. The visual-polish change is body-HTML-only; no API contract or DB schema changed in this iteration.
rca of the issue: Not a bug iteration — this iteration was a visual polish (timeline looked plain on grk.fm). The fix replaces consumer-CSS dependency with inline styles + a rounded status pill, switches <ol> to <ul> to drop browser-default numbering, and ensures every <li> has list-style:none even when the consumer theme has aggressive global <li> rules. Verified by re-running both regression suites green and by spot-checking the constants in _render_liveblog_html against each acceptance bullet.
